description: §22.12 closed allow-list (S457) — a RUNTIME `^{}` body (no emit / reflect; it uses the `meta` API) referencing `globalThis`. The allow-list applies to every `^{}` body whatever its classification: `globalThis` is not a scrml construct, a local or captured binding, or a meta primitive, so it is E-META-001. (The S134 deny list named nine host globals and let this one through.)
